acceptanceCriteria: operator-update-v0 states a retention bound and apply/rollback enforce it, naming removed directories.
A test proves an interrupted transaction without receipt.json is swept on the next run and rollback still works.
body:
Observed 2026-10-07 by a read-only cleanup audit of the orchestrator session (code at batch 4 head 5808c26c; installed corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360, corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202). Owner goal: keep Corvint lean and efficient on disk and CPU.

Confirmed. ~/.local/share/corvint/updates/transaction-3135536169 holds 61 MiB (download, unpacked copy, previous binary, test home). Each apply adds a new transaction directory and docs/specs/operator-update-v0.md sets no retention bound; rollback needs only the latest one.

Suspected, not observed: a killed apply leaves a transaction-* directory without receipt.json, because cleanup is only a defer (internal/update/update.go:143-151).

Expected: a bounded retention (for example the latest rollback-capable transaction plus none of the downloads/unpacked copies), and an incomplete transaction is swept on the next run.
Actual: unbounded growth.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#649 (rc3 cleanup), merged to main 2026-10-07T13:49:36Z as ce6313a015bf94d1dc675eb2130b2c2c3851c65a. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-07-update-transaction-retention.md, docs/decisions/0440-rc3-cleanup-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md and the sealed CEM .corvint/changes/48c959dbb62e0cc79ed4c81cc90a524920827e0f.cem.json at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256). The build-log entry records the change, the maintained tests and the Codex review with its repairs; decision 0440 records the owner's acceptance of UPD-V0-007. The batch passed focused package tests, go vet on darwin/linux/windows, the doc gates, dogfood check and seal, and every hosted CI check on the merge head. NOT_RUN: make gate, the live macOS update lifecycle, Linux dispatcher runtime and live dispatcher qualification. Native complete is refused with STALE_TREE (V1-0557), hence manual completion.

title: corvint-update keeps every transaction directory forever
